title: Code snippet reveal
summary: An editor window types a short program with a human rhythm and syntax highlighting, the key line lights up while the rest dims, a terminal shows what it prints and a takeaway closes the piece.
techniques: seeded human typing rhythm scaled to a beat
gallery_share: Code reels and coding-tip shorts are among the most common developer-education videos on social platforms.
limits: The tokenizer is line-based, not a parser: unusual syntax may stay uncoloured
Code and output are displayed, never run: a person must confirm the output is correct
Up to 16 lines of 56 characters (about 40 in 9:16 at a legible size)
One monospace face from the system (JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono or Noto Sans Mono)
